اهتلكا (form VIII)
# اِهْتَلَكَا (ihtalakā) /ih.ta.la.kaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِهْتَلَكَ (ihtalaka)
# اُهْتُلِكَا (uhtulikā) /uh.tu.li.kaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِهْتَلَكَ (ihtalaka)
# اِهْتَلِكَا (ihtalikā) /ih.ta.li.kaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِهْتَلَكَ (ihtalaka)
